programme.title: Family Plan
programme.desc: Charlie works for a company that is taken over by Walcott who believes family values are a priority. Career-driven Charlie does a little fibbing when under the pressure of Walcott's standards, and believes she's in the clear. But when Walcott invites himself over for dinner, she borrows her friend's house and daughter and hires actor Buck to play her husband for the evening. The one-night "act" turns into a full-time gig when her boss decides to rent the house next door for the summer, forcing Charlie and Buck to stay together in the fake lifestyle she created.

programme.title: The Forbidden Kingdom

One day he makes an amazing discovery: in one of Chinatown shops he finds the legendary staff which belongs to the great warrior Monkey King. The magic staff sends Jason on an adventure to ancient China, where he joins an army of highly skilled warriors gathered to free their imprisoned king.

programme.title: The Royal Scandal
programme.desc: Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes - the world's greatest detective - faces a most alluring adversary... Legendary opera star Irene Adler is threatening to destroy the King of Bohemia's reputation with proof of their illicit affair. The evidence? A photograph. Her ransom? The king's hand in marriage. But not only does investigating detective Sherlock Holmes already know Irene from the past, he also knows that the queen of manipulation would never resort to such a common crime. After uncovering her true ambitions, Holmes draws the cunning songstress into a well-matched game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: King Solomon's Mines
programme.desc: This re-telling of the eighteen century novel of the same name, by H. Rider Haggard, features Patrick Swayze. The main character (Swayze), is called Allan Quatermain and is a treasure hunter in search this time, of King Solomon's hidden treasure. With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Brand new series: Walter Presents - which showcases the best foreign language drama from around the world - features this darkly atmospheric Swedish series in which a mother reunites her three adult children and forces them to confront the family secrets buried in their past. A beautiful island in the Swedish Alandic archipelago is home to a popular lodge, run by Anna-Lisa Waldemar and her youngest son Oskar. Mysteriously, Anna-Lisa has summoned her eldest son Lasse and her daughter Jonna home - it's the first time the family have been together in years. Despite the idyllic setting, the homecoming is full of conflict, arousing old memories, resentments and secrets. No one knows why they have been brought back and all three siblings are keen for the weekend to be over. However, her children are unaware that Anna-Lisa has a hidden agenda and a plan that is set to change their lives for ever. Starring Joel Spira, Bjorn Bengtsson, Aliette Opheim, Stina Ekblad, Torkel Pettersson, Jessica Grabowsky, Saga Sarkola, Molly Nutley and Tobias Zilliacus. In Swedish with English subtitles.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Virtus" - "Paris"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Kauno „Žalgiris“ - Barselonos „FC Barcelona“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Killer Three
programme.desc: This series looks at the natural born killers of the animal kingdom with each episode focusing on a particular, shared aspect of what makes these creatures successful predators. In 'Little Killers', we see how a lack of physical size can be overcome when hunting prey and miniscule attackers are able to bring down prey that are massive in comparison. In 'Speed Kills', the spotlight is shone on those predators who use their incredibly fast skills to catch their food. From the fastest animal on land, the cheetah, to the stargazer fish that dispatches its prey in a tenth of a second to the deadly black mamba, some of these attacks are so fast that they cannot be captured using slow-motion. In 'Hunger Games', the emphasis is placed on the driving force behind the majority of attacks, the desire for food.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals survive by using camouflage, mimicry, and stealth tactics. From tigers who hunt in plain sight using their orange fur as camouflage, and a spider who mimics an ant to sneak into a colony, to a bird that uses false alarm calls to trick meerkats into giving up their prey, nature deploys remarkable deception to survive.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: In the wild, animals face life or death battles every day, from escaping deadly predators to fighting off fierce rivals. Sometimes brute force isn't enough to prevail. Survival can depend on death-defying acrobatics, secret senses and hidden weapons - the extraordinary superpowers that help animals survive.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: In nature, the prevailing rule is "eat or be eaten." Avoiding predators and competition for space, food, and mates is a priority for every animal. But before you can attack, you need to be able to defend yourself. After eons of evolution, animals have developed powerful and surprising defensive techniques that help them avoid, overcome, or escape challengers.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Race to Winter
programme.desc: As the first light of spring touches snow-covered landscapes, the race begins. Across fjords, forests, mountains and tundra, animals emerge from hiding to take advantage of summer's fleeting generosity. But the clock is ticking, and winter is never far away. Brown bear mothers supervise their wayward cubs; puffins reunite in lifelong pairs atop perilous ledges; a polar bear mother searches for food in a land where the ice has receded and her usual prey has vanished. As summer fades, the mighty moose faces wolves in the silent snow. Arctic foxes raise their young and scavenge in brutal temperatures, surviving on scraps others cannot digest. Each species is tied to the land and to each other in a delicate web of survival. In this race against the cold, only the most remarkable endure.

programme.title: Dragons Uncovered
programme.desc: The Komodo Dragon has captured our imaginations for over a century, yet so much about this incredible lizard remains a mystery. A creature with survival skills and physical characteristics seen in apex predators across the animal kingdom, and the ability to take down predators ten times its size. The secrets of the Komodo Dragon are revealed.

programme.title: Wild Hawaii
programme.desc: Documentary series. Nicknamed The Paradise of the Pacific, Hawaii is an archipelago like no other. Its 137 islands are spread across volcanic topography, with the unstable landscapes constantly changing. Though more renowned for its pristine beaches and luscious palms, Hawaii is a wild and untamed area of brutal, natural beauty. Whether it's the unfathomably gigantic waves that crash into its reefs and shores, or the pourings of molten lava from its active volcanoes, the state encompasses all of nature's viciousness and peacefulness in one, with an abundance of delightful wildlife thriving on these unsettled islands.

From tiny puppies and rabbits, large cows and horses, and creepy crawlies, on this episode of The Incredible Dr. Pol, it's a fun mix of, "aww," "wow," and "yuck!" The vets are out on farms calls! Dr. Pol tangles with a feisty angus bull, pregnancy checks a herd at House Dairy, and pays a visit to Clay Knob to look at a cow with a peculiar problem.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to southern Vietnam's tropical habitats, home to gibbons and playful macaques, green sea turtles, and Asian black bears. Reintroduced Siamese crocodiles roam the Bau Sau wetlands. The vast Mekong Delta boasts small-clawed otters and thousands of migrating birds, from openbill storks to Oriental darters.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Sierra Morena is a mountain range of climatic extremes. The harsh winter puts the lynxes of the Jandula River Valley to the test. Golden eagles, otters, wild boars and cormorants struggle to survive in the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to Vietnam's mountainous forests to discover endangered pangolins, Asian palm civets, and the golden-headed langurs of Cat Ba Island. The recently discovered Vietnamese crocodile lizard is already vulnerable to smuggling, while the critically endangered Delacour's langurs take refuge in a nature reserve. In springtime, an astonishing diversity of butterfly species congregates in the forest.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: Living Edens
programme.desc: Life and death are close companions in an Eden called Costa Rica. Nestled in the tropics of Central America, Costa Rica calls itself the land of "Pura Vida" - pure life. In a phenomenon known as the "Arribada", the arrival, olive ridley sea turtles migrate annually in massive numbers while troops of capuchin, squirrel, howler monkeys and resplendent quetzals forage in the canopy above. Below roam deadly army ants, poison dart frogs and the strongest insect on earth, the Hercules beetle.

programme.title: Underdogs
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds assembles "The Superzeros," a team of somewhat pitiful animals with unexpectedly awesome superpowers. Forget about the cheetah's speed and the eagle's eyesight; and say hello to the invisible glass frog, the indestructible honey badger and the might of the pistol shrimp who can fire bubbles hotter than the sun.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory explores the extraordinary lives of bees — among the planet's most important animals. Over three years, special cameras opened a rare window into a single hive, revealing their hidden world. But with more than 20,000 bee species pollinating one-third of the world's food, this series uncovers their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory returns to the honeybee sisterhood as they race to rebuild before winter. Across the planet, other bees face challenges of their own — from Dawson's bees battling for mates to honeybees facing the global spread of varroa mites. With Explorer Dr. Sammy Ramsey, Bertie explores the mounting pressures on bees and bold solutions to secure their future.

programme.title: Asia's Killer Hornets
programme.desc: Every Asian giant hornet colony starts with a single queen. These hornets will sacrifice everything to help raise legions of grubs and protect the hive at all costs.

programme.title: Venom Files - Anatomy of a Snake Bite
programme.desc: Millions are bitten by snakes each year, yet their venom evolved for hunting, not harming humans. Explore the fascinating and deadly adaptations of the king cobra, black mamba, inland taipan, puff adder, saw-scaled viper, Mozambique spitting cobra and the fearsome boomslang. Journey from India's vibrant villages to Africa's wild bush and Australia's outback to witness how venom paralyzes, digests and protects. Discover why every snakebite is different — and how our worlds collide in surprising ways. Each snake's venom tells a story, engineered to hunt, defend and survive. But as humans and snakes collide, the chemistry that once kept balance now brings catastrophe. "Venom Files" reveals nature's deadliest assassins.

programme.title: Born in Africa
programme.desc: Born in Africa is a documentary following the stories of newborns in five animal families in the African savanna, from their first steps to the moment they become independent. These little lions, cheetahs, hyenas, meerkats and jackals must face many challenges along the way, as their mothers do everything to protect them in these most vulnerable stages of life. Watch them as they grow and learn how to move and get by in the wilderness in this intimate portrayal of family dynamics in the natural world.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: In the wild, animals face life or death battles every day, from escaping deadly predators to fighting off fierce rivals. Sometimes brute force isn't enough to prevail. Survival can depend on death-defying acrobatics, secret senses and hidden weapons - the extraordinary superpowers that help animals survive.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals survive by using camouflage, mimicry, and stealth tactics. From tigers who hunt in plain sight using their orange fur as camouflage, and a spider who mimics an ant to sneak into a colony, to a bird that uses false alarm calls to trick meerkats into giving up their prey, nature deploys remarkable deception to survive.

programme.title: Deadly Instincts
programme.desc: Beyond the 50/50 coin toss of fight or flight, survival really is a numbers game. Your threats stack up: primed predators, child killers, cruel nature. Whether through courage, wisdom, strength, or by leveraging super-powers, the survivors make it - against all odds.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: In the wild, animals face life or death battles every day, from escaping deadly predators to fighting off fierce rivals. Sometimes brute force isn't enough to prevail. Survival can depend on death-defying acrobatics, secret senses and hidden weapons - the extraordinary superpowers that help animals survive.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: The PVS staff make sure every animal has a fighting chance. From tiny puppies and rabbits, large cows and horses, and creepy crawlies, on this episode of The Incredible Dr. Pol, it's a fun mix of, "aww," "wow," and "yuck!" The vets are out on farms calls! Dr. Pol tangles with a feisty angus bull, pregnancy checks a herd at House Dairy, and pays a visit to Clay Knob to look at a cow with a peculiar problem.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory returns to the honeybee sisterhood as they race to rebuild before winter. Across the planet, other bees face challenges of their own — from Dawson's bees battling for mates to honeybees facing the global spread of varroa mites. With Explorer Dr. Sammy Ramsey, Bertie explores the mounting pressures on bees and bold solutions to secure their future.

programme.title: Born in Africa
programme.desc: Born in Africa is a documentary following the stories of newborns in five animal families in the African savanna, from their first steps to the moment they become independent. These little lions, cheetahs, hyenas, meerkats and jackals must face many challenges along the way, as their mothers do everything to protect them in these most vulnerable stages of life. Watch them as they grow and learn how to move and get by in the wilderness in this intimate portrayal of family dynamics in the natural world.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Action-packed animation. Four pizza-loving brothers, Raph, Leo, Donnie and Mikey, are mutant turtles who live in the sewers under the streets of New York City. Raph is the oldest of the brothers and also their leader. Leo is the sword-swinging trickster of the team. Donnie is the smartest of the group and Mikey is the youngest brother and also the joker of the bunch. The adventures they go on help them discover their mystic ninja powers and understand the world around them. They learn to work better as a team of heroes. Skills they will need when faced with the enemies who wish to defeat the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: T.U.F.F. Puppy
programme.desc: Mall Rat: After spending time in prison, Snaptrap convinces the T.U.F.F. agents that he wants to shed his acts of villainy. Kitty remains unconvinced even when Snaptrap goes on a "good deed" spree and gives out free goodies to the citizens of Petropolis. When Snaptrap reveals his true intentions and launches the crowded Petropolis mall into the sun, it's up to Kitty to save them from imminent danger.Operation: Happy Birthday:Dudley is determined to give Kitty the best birthday of her life, so he plans a surprise party at T.U.F.F. HQ and give her what she's always wanted: to defeat a bad guy during her special day. But the festivities are threatened when the crime-busting duo's latest mission requires them to stop Snaptrap's plan to rid the world of cheese with a giant cheese magnet.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Gullible Pants: SpongeBob is left in charge of the Krusty Krab while Mr. Krabs steps out for 15 minutes, and he is determined to make it the best-managed 15 minutes ever! Overbooked: SpongeBob's got a full day, and he's determined to do everything he's scheduled to do: help fix Mr. Krabs' telescope, go to Patrick's birthday party, and help with Sandy's science presentation. Too bad everything's scheduled for the same exact time!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

Spuds even ENCOURAGES Raph to work out his anger and negativity through fighting, even if his family and the annoying Pigeon Pete don't get it. But although the Turtles don't see eye to eye, they must work together to stop a rampaging Rocksteady and Bebop from wrecking the city! Social media blew up with videos of the two Mutanimals going berserk, fighting each other without seeming to know what was going on around them. And all the while, doing some serious damage to the city! As the dust settles, is there someone behind the whole plot, pulling the strings?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: All of Raph's wildest dreams are coming true in the underground Mutant Battle Arena! He gets to let loose, fighting the massive Mutanimals Bebop and Rocksteady; even the hug-loving Mondo Gecko joins in on the fun! Raph doesn't hold back, and he gets his butt kicked with a smile on his face. Not only that, he's getting some serious bling in exchange for being part of the fights - gold chains, new clothes, even his very own vehicle, the TURTLE TANK! This makes Donnie, Leo, and Mikey very suspicious, since Raph has kept everything a secret from them. But audiences love Raph, which pleases the crime boss Kitsune and her street gang, the Purple Dragons. They run the arena with the help of an obnoxious investor named Knox. programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: English Football League Championship
programme.desc: The English Football League Championship or the "EFL" as it is otherwise referred to, is the stepping stone from the wilderness of English football, to the riches associated with the promised land, that is the 'English Premier League'. In keeping with traditions of this club championship, we bring you first-hand, live coverage of developments for this division. Touted as one of the hardest leagues to manoeuvre out of, it was founded in 2004 and has truly delivered with its play-off system, offering a whole new dimension of entertainment, compared to other leagues out there. From "Sleeping Giants" such as Nottingham Forest & Sheffield Wednesday, to the jostling pack of Preston & Brentford, marquee match-ups every week will decide the final Championship standings, come the end of May.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Football: FA Cup
programme.desc: The FA Cup is the oldest knock-out tournament in England. Provided the Football Association, the competition provides raw emotion through "giant-killings" and 'underdog stories'. Premier League clubs enter in the third round of the tournament and with non-league teams starting the proceedings , n the early qualifying rounds, it promises to be another successful spectacle for viewers. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.desc: Western restaurato di Sergio Leone con James Coburn e Rod Steiger. Un fuorilegge messicano si allea con un rapinatore irlandese e si trova a combattere per la Rivoluzione di Villa e Zapata.

programme.title: Habemus Papam
programme.desc: Nanni Moretti dirige e interpreta, con Michel Piccoli e Margherita Buy, una pellicola su un'inaspettata crisi esistenziale. Il nuovo Papa, assalito dall'ansia, rinuncia alla sua missione.

programme.title: Nato il quattro luglio
programme.desc: Due Oscar al biopic di Oliver Stone con Tom Cruise. La vera storia di Ron Kovic: rimasto paralizzato nell'inferno del Vietnam, torna in patria e diventa un leader pacifista.

programme.title: Il campione
programme.desc: Emozionante pellicola di Leonardo D'Agostini con Stefano Accorsi e Andrea Carpenzano. Per disciplinare un giovane fuoriclasse, il presidente gli affianca un insegnante privato.

programme.title: Il colibrì
programme.desc: Francesca Archibugi dirige Pierfrancesco Favino, Nanni Moretti e Kasia Smutniak, dal romanzo di Sandro Veronesi. La vita di un uomo, fra dure prove e ricordi, a partire dal suo primo amore.

programme.title: The Outfit
programme.desc: Thriller che segna l'esordio alla regia per Graham Moore, con Mark Rylance e Zoey Deutch. Chicago, anni 50: la bottega di un sarto inglese diventa l'epicentro di una faida tra gangster.

programme.title: Dante
programme.desc: Biopic con Sergio Castellitto e Alessandro Sperduti, diretti da Pupi Avati. 30 anni dopo la morte di Dante Alighieri, il Boccaccio ne ripercorre la vita in un viaggio da Firenze e Ravenna.

programme.title: Il miglio verde
programme.desc: Tom Hanks nel dramma carcerario tratto dal romanzo di Stephen King. 1935: un gigantesco uomo di colore, dotato di poteri curativi, viene condannato a morte per omicidio.

programme.title: Avvocato Ligas
programme.desc: Varie partenze inattese e vecchie ferite portano Lorenzo a raggiungere il limite, ma un ritorno dal passatp potrebbe mettere tutto di nuovo in discussione.

programme.title: Rapina a Stoccolma
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke e Noomi Rapace nella rievocazione di una rapina storica. Agosto, 1973: un uomo irrompe in una banca della capitale svedese prendendo in ostaggio i dipendenti. Con il passare dei giorni, i prigionieri stringono un legame di complicità con il loro sequestratore.

programme.title: Avvocato Ligas
programme.desc: Varie partenze inattese e vecchie ferite portano Lorenzo a raggiungere il limite, ma un ritorno dal passatp potrebbe mettere tutto di nuovo in discussione.

programme.title: Anora
programme.desc: 5 Oscar e Palma d'oro a Cannes alla travolgente commedia di Sean Baker con Mikey Madison e Mark Eydelshteyn. Una spogliarellista di New York sposa il figlio miliardario di un oligarca russo, ma i suoceri inviano i loro sgherri negli Stati Uniti per annullare il matrimonio.

programme.title: Attacco a Mumbai - Una vera storia di coraggio
programme.desc: L’inferno del terrorismo in un infuocato dramma tratto da una storia vera, con Armie Hammer e Dev Patel. Nel novembre 2008 un gruppo di jihadisti armati sbarca a Mumbai per compiere una serie di attentati in vari punti della città e prendere d’assalto un storico albergo di lusso.

programme.title: Ben Hur
programme.desc: 11 Oscar per il leggendario kolossal di William Wyler, con Charlton Heston. Il principe Ben Hur, caduto prigioniero per colpa di Messala, cerca vendetta nei confronti del suo nemico.

programme.title: Nel nostro cielo un rombo di tuono
programme.desc: Riccardo Milani dirige un docu-film biografico sul campione Gigi Riva. Dall'infanzia alla gloria, la vita e la carriera del grande calciatore e il suo forte legame con la Sardegna.

programme.title: Radioactive
programme.desc: Rosamund Pike, Sam Riley e Anya Taylor-Joy nella biografia di Marie Curie. La vita della scienziata polacca, naturalizzata francese, che ha cambiato il mondo con le sue scoperte, salendo in cattedra in una società dominata dagli uomini e aggiudicandosi per due volte il Nobel.

programme.title: Rapina a Stoccolma
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke e Noomi Rapace nella rievocazione di una rapina storica. Agosto, 1973: un uomo irrompe in una banca della capitale svedese prendendo in ostaggio i dipendenti. Con il passare dei giorni, i prigionieri stringono un legame di complicità con il loro sequestratore.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Chris Hemsworth e Daniel Bruhl nel biopic sulla rivalita' fra i piloti James Hunt e Niki Lauda, protagonisti di una memorabile stagione della Formula Uno.

programme.title: Il Concorso
programme.desc: Keira Knightley e Gugu Mbatha-Raw nel biopic su una storica battaglia femminista. Londra, 1970: il ‘Women's Liberation Movement’ irrompe in diretta televisiva durante il concorso per l’elezione di Miss Mondo in segno di protesta contro la strumentalizzazione delle donne.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: Biopic di Aaron Sorkin con Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba e Kevin Costner. Dopo un infortunio, la sciatrice olimpionica Molly Bloom cambia vita e diventa la regina del poker clandestino.

programme.title: Ben Hur
programme.desc: 11 Oscar per il leggendario kolossal di William Wyler, con Charlton Heston. Il principe Ben Hur, caduto prigioniero per colpa di Messala, cerca vendetta nei confronti del suo nemico.

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca
programme.desc: John Cena e Brian Cox nella pellicola targata Sky Original. Una giovane giornalista scopre una cospirazione che coinvolge un candidato alla Presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: Western di Quentin Tarantino con un supercast. In un rifugio di montagna, otto sconosciuti si scontrano fra minacce, inganni e pallottole. Oscar alle musiche di Ennio Morricone.

programme.title: Paz!
programme.desc: Claudio Santamaria in una commedia generazionale ispirata ai fumetti di Andrea Pazienza. La storia di tre ragazzi che condividono un appartamento di periferia nella Bologna degli anni 70.

programme.title: Reagan: Un Presidente sotto i riflettori
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid, Penelope Ann Miller e Jon Voight nel biopic che ripercorre la vita privata e politica di Ronald Reagan, Presidente degli Stati Uniti negli anni 80. Dall'infanzia in Illinois, alla carriera hollywoodiana fino al palcoscenico mondiale come capo della Casa Bianca.

programme.title: Ligabue - 30 anni in un giorno
programme.desc: Ligabue fa i conti con i suoi ricordi e con la sua carriera nel biopic incentrato sul leggendario concerto di Campovolo del 2022.

programme.title: The Young Messiah
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Anne Rice, una pellicola che ripercorre l'infanzia di Gesu'. A 7 anni il futuro Messia lascia l'Egitto per tornare a Nazareth dove scopre le sue vere origini.

programme.title: Ben Hur
programme.desc: 11 Oscar per il leggendario kolossal di William Wyler, con Charlton Heston. Il principe Ben Hur, caduto prigioniero per colpa di Messala, cerca vendetta nei confronti del suo nemico.

programme.title: Le Mans '66 - La grande sfida
programme.desc: Due Oscar per il biopic di James Mangold con Christian Bale e Matt Damon, sulla storica sfida tra Ford e Ferrari. Carroll Shelby ha vinto la prestigiosa 24 Ore di Le Mans nel 1959 ma una patologia cardiaca gli proibisce di continuare a gareggiare. Si reinventa allora designer di automobili e accetta la proposta della Ford: progettare una macchina in grado di battere il bolide della Ferrari. Ma oltre al motore, per vincere serve anche un pilota super. E la scelta di Shelby ricade su Ken Miles, un intrepido e irascibile pilota britannico. Nel cast Remo Girone interpreta Enzo Ferrari.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: The Untouchables - Gli intoccabili
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Connery, nel capolavoro di Brian De Palma con Kevin Costner e Robert De Niro. Chicago, 1930: una squadra speciale viene incaricata di incastrare Al Capone.

programme.title: Il Maestro
programme.desc: Estate, fine anni Ottanta. Un ex tennista, deluso dalla sua mediocre carriera, diventa l'allenatore di un giovane talento timido, schiacciato dalle aspettative del padre. I due affrontano le loro paure e insicurezze.

programme.title: Unbroken
programme.desc: Sceneggiato dai fratelli Coen, war movie biografico di Angelina Jolie. Seconda guerra mondiale: reclutato in aviazione, l'atleta Louis Zamperini finisce in mano ai giapponesi nel Pacifico.

programme.title: Il Padrino: Epilogo - La morte di Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Capitolo finale della trilogia, restaurato e rimontato da Francis Ford Coppola. Il sessantenne Mike Corleone individua in Vincent il successore del suo impero criminale.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano i più grandi successi del trio comico più amato d'Italia, disponibili su Sky Cinema e on demand.

programme.title: Chiedimi se sono felice
programme.desc: Tre amici, frustrati da una vita lavorativa non appagante, vorrebbero mettere in scena un adattamento del Cyrano de Bergerac. Quando a loro si unisce l'attrice amatoriale Marina, la situazione si complica all'inverosimile.

programme.title: Tu la conosci Claudia?
programme.desc: Claudia e Giovanni sono in piena crisi matrimoniale. La donna è convinta che concentrandosi nell'aiuto agli altri riuscirà a risolvere il problema e ruba quindi dallo studio della propria psicanalista la cartella di un altro paziente.

programme.title: Odio l'estate
programme.desc: Aldo, Giovanni e Giacomo nella commedia di successo di Massimo Venier. Per un errore, tre famiglie sono costrette a passare le vacanze estive nella stessa casa al mare.
